verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's install docs say it can be run with Docker, with Docker Compose recommended, and its CLI logs in to 'your GlitchTip instance' at a user-supplied URL. Several independent users report self-hosting it, calling it 'super easy to self-host', stable, and needing only four components (backend, workers, Redis, PostgreSQL); one user found deployment a bit hard but blamed Sentry's open-source design. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party self-hosting documentation in the evidence (the install docs are a single line), and explicit evidence of the open-source license or which features self-hosted instances include.
